mapper.select: SELECT INT_RATE_ID AS intRateId, /**行情代码**/ EFF_DATE AS effDate, /**生效日**/ INT_RATE AS intRate /**利率**/ FROM ( SELECT INT_RATE_ID, EFF_DATE, INT_RATE, /*ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY INT_RATE_ID ORDER BY EFF_DATE desc) AS rn*/ rn FROM ( SELECT result.* FROM ( SELECT tmp.*, @rownum := @rownum + 1 row, /* 虚拟列行标 */ IF((@INT_RATE_ID = tmp.INT_RATE_ID), @rank := @rank + 1, @rank := 1 ) AS rn, /* 分组虚拟列行标 */ @INT_RATE_ID := tmp.INT_RATE_ID FROM ( SELECT * FROM MST_INT_RATE_INFO bc ORDER BY EFF_DATE DESC ) tmp, (SELECT @rownum := 0, @INT_RATE_ID := null, @rank := 0) a ) result ) WHERE EFF_DATE <=#{selectDate} AND INT_RATE_ID = #{intRateId} ORDER BY EFF_DATE desc ) WHERE rn = 1

SELECT ple.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID, prd.FINPROD_TYPE AS pledgeFinprodType, ple.PLEDGE_NUMBER, prd.TRADE_MARKET, prd.REGIST_ORG FROM FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT fin INNER JOIN FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE ple ON fin.FINPROD_ID = ple.FINPROD_ID /** AND fin.FINPROD_TYPE = ple.FINPROD_TYPE **/ AND fin.BRANCH = ple.BRANCH LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT prd ON ple.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID = prd.FINPROD_ID /** AND ple.PLEDGE_FINPROD_TYPE = prd.FINPROD_TYPE **/ WHERE fin.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType} AND fin.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND fin.BRANCH_TYPE is null AND fin.BRANCH = 0

select A.FINPROD_ID as finprodId, A.FINPROD_TYPE as finprodType, A.VAL_DATE as valDate, A.VALUATION as valuation, A.INPUT_TYPE as inputType from FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION A where A.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and A.VAL_DATE = #{valDate}

SELECT distinct A.FINPROD_ID chlId, ifnull(A.FINPROD_ABBR, A.FINPROD_NAME) chlName, b.COLLECT_TYPE collectType FROM FIN_PRODUCT A INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD B ON A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO FCI ON A.FINPROD_ID = FCI.CHL_FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP ON FCI.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID WHERE A.IS_CHL = 'Y' AND A.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F28' /** 通道 F28**/ AND FCI.CHL_LEVEL = 1 AND FP.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}
